title: aphanes microcarpa
intro: Aphanes microcarpa, commonly known as dwarf teasel or woodruff, is a perennial plant species within the family Rosaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Aphanes microcarpa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. These bioactive constituents are believed to contribute to the plant's potential therapeutic uses in treating a range of conditions, including gastrointestinal disorders and skin irritations.
